operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.712, subd. 7): (1) semiautomatic rifle that has the capacity to accept a detachable magazine and has at least two of the following: ... (3) semiautomatic shotgun that has two or more of the following:
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 1): It is unlawful to transfer a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 3): A person who violates subdivision 1 is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.
Section 3 (buyback program): The commissioner of public safety shall create a voluntary semiautomatic military-style assault weapon buyback program. Nothing in this section compels the owner of a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to sell the owner's semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to law enforcement or a firearms dealer.
Section 4 (appropriation): $500,000 in fiscal year 2019 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the implementation of the voluntary semiautomatic military-style assault weapon buyback program under section 3.
